newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton output reaches 3.464 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton output reaches 3.464 mln bales.

text.p: The state-run Cotton Export Corporation of Pakistan said on Sunday cotton output in the 1996/97 (July-June) crop year had reached a provisional 3.464 million 375-lb bales by November 7, up from 2.499 million bales in the same period last year.
It said mills had bought 2.385 million bales, up from 1.667 million in the year-ago period, while exporters had purchased just 1,000 bales against 110,600 by the same date last year.
A total of 1.079 million unsold bales was stocked at ginning factories, up from 722,100 in the year-ago period.
Officials have brought their 1996/97 crop estimate down to 9.2 to 9.4 million bales after pest damage in recent months, mainly in Punjab, Pakistan's major cotton-producing province.
The estimate is down from earlier predictions of 10 million bales and last year's production of 9.96 million.
